messages.subject: Anyone using Distance on WinXP?
parts:
Hi distance-sampling list,

Has anyone who uses Distance 4.1 under Windows XP encountered a problem where it
seemingly cannot find the analysis engine when you run an analysis? I have a
report (below) from a user in Australia and I can't figure out what the problem
may be. If you've had a similar problem, pleae contact me.

Thanks!

- Len

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hi guys,

I am a new user. I have gone through the project wizard to set up a project and
have entered dummy line transect data; angles and radial distance figures. I
then go to run the analysis and there are no results and the following in the
input screen (I am running windows XP 2002):

Initializing

Making Data File

Making Data Selection Queries

Making Input File

Starting engine

-- Start of Analyis Engine Log File --

-- End of Analyis Engine Log File --

** Warning: Analysis engine wrote some output to the console error stream,
reproduced below. **

-- Start of Console Error Stream --

'C:\PROGRA~1\Distance' is not recognized as an internal or external command,
operable program or batch file.

-- End of Console Error Stream --

Analysis engine status 'OK'

Reading Results

Run finished
